recentFiles.title: Recent Files
recentFiles.empty: No files opened yet. Tap Open to pick one.
recentFiles.reopenFailedMessage: The file may have been moved or deleted, or not yet downloaded from iCloud. Tap Open to pick it again, or try again later.
recentFiles.renameMessage: Enter a new file name (.md is added automatically).
recentFiles.renameErrorInUse: A file with that name already exists. Choose a different name.
recentFiles.deleteFileMessage: This deletes the file from iCloud Drive › Modrift. This can't be undone.
recentFiles.deleteSelectedMessage: Removed from your home folder. This can't be undone.
recentFiles.nameCloudMessage: This name will show for every file from this cloud (e.g. Google Drive). Leave blank to reset.
recentFiles.myFilesEmpty: No files in your home folder yet. Tap ＋ to create one.
recentFiles.clearHistoryMessage: This clears your Recent list. The files themselves are not deleted.

viewer.copyToHomeDialogMessage: A copy of this file will be created in your home (iCloud › Modrift). The original is left unchanged. You can edit the copy in your home.
viewer.copyToIcloudErrorIcloudUnavailable: Enable iCloud Drive and try again.
viewer.conflictMessage: This file was updated by another device or app after you opened it. Overwrite it with your edits, or load the latest version.

settings.cloudNamesHint: iOS doesn't reveal which cloud a file comes from. Name them here and it shows in your history.
settings.homeLocationHint: Switching won't move your existing files.
settings.homeLocationToLocalMessage: Switch to Local. Your iCloud files will be hidden for now (not deleted). Local files are not synced to iCloud or backed up, and are lost if you delete the app.
settings.homeLocationToIcloudMessage: Switch to iCloud. Your Local files will be hidden for now (not deleted). Using iCloud requires iCloud Drive to be enabled.

pro.locked: Viewing this format is available with Pro.

picker.errorReadFailed: Couldn't open the file. It may not be downloaded to this device yet — open it once in its app (Google Drive, Files, etc.) or check your connection, then try again.
picker.unsupportedType: This file type isn't supported. Open a .md, .markdown, .txt, .text, or .pdf file.
